Description: Sellers see everything about an account on one page: contacts, contracts, open opportunities, tickets and recent activity, so that no call starts without context.
A clear pipeline with stages, a forecast that managers trust and early warnings for deals that are stuck.
Create a quote in minutes with correct prices, discount rules and approvals, without leaving the app.

Summary: AI assistant and next best action
Description: An assistant that proposes the next step per account, drafts follow-ups and answers questions about the pipeline, always naming its sources.

Summary: View all contacts and roles of an account
Description:
As a seller I want to see the contacts of an account with their role (sponsor, decision maker, user) so that I know whom to address.

Acceptance criteria:
* Contacts are listed with name, role, e-mail and last contact date.
* A role can be set or changed in two clicks.
* Accounts without a decision maker show a hint.

Summary: Show contracts and renewal dates on the account page
Description:
As a seller I want to see all contracts of an account with end date and decision date so that I never miss a renewal.

Acceptance criteria:
* Each contract shows product, annual value, end date and decision date.
* Renewals with a decision date in the next 90 days are highlighted red, yellow or green.
* A click opens the contract details.

Summary: Show open tickets and escalations on the account page
Description:
As a seller I want to see open service tickets of the account so that I do not walk into a meeting unaware of an escalation.

Acceptance criteria:
* Open tickets show priority, age and owner.
* Critical tickets appear at the top.
* The list refreshes when the page is opened.

Summary: Record a call or meeting note in under 30 seconds
Description:
As a seller I want to log a note by typing or dictating so that the account history stays complete without effort.

Acceptance criteria:
* A note can be saved with a single field and a date.
* Voice input is available on mobile.
* Notes appear in the account timeline immediately.

Summary: Kanban view of the pipeline by stage
Description:
As a seller I want to see my opportunities as cards in stages so that I can move them by drag and drop.

Acceptance criteria:
* Stages are Qualify, Propose, Negotiate, Close.
* Moving a card changes the stage and stores who did it and when.
* The column header shows count and total value.

As a sales manager I want a forecast weighted by stage probability so that I can commit a number I trust.

Acceptance criteria:
* The forecast shows commit, best case and pipeline for the current quarter.
* The probability per stage can be changed by an admin.
* Changes since last week are shown as a delta.

Summary: Flag deals without activity for 14 days
Description:
As a sales manager I want deals without activity to be flagged so that stuck deals get attention early.

Acceptance criteria:
* A deal without activity for 14 days gets a yellow flag, after 28 days a red flag.
* The threshold can be changed per team.
* The seller gets a notification once per flag.

Summary: Win/loss reason when closing a deal
Description:
As a sales manager I want a required reason when a deal is won or lost so that we learn from outcomes.

Acceptance criteria:
* A closing deal cannot be saved without a reason from a defined list.
* A free text comment is optional.
* Reasons are available in the pipeline report.

Summary: Create a quote from a product catalogue
Description:
As a seller I want to build a quote from the product catalogue so that prices and terms are correct.

Acceptance criteria:
* Products are searchable and show list price and unit.
* The quote shows subtotal, discount and total per year.
* A quote can be saved as draft and exported as PDF.

Summary: Discount rules with approval above a threshold
Description:
As a sales manager I want discounts above a threshold to need my approval so that margins are protected.

Acceptance criteria:
* A discount above 15 percent sends an approval request to the regional lead.
* The seller sees the status of the request.
* The decision and reason are stored with the quote.

Summary: Reuse an earlier quote as a template
Description:
As a seller I want to copy a previous quote so that I do not start from zero for similar customers.

Acceptance criteria:
* A quote can be copied with all lines.
* Prices are refreshed to the current price list on copy.
* The copy links back to its source.

Summary: Next best action card per account
Description:
As a seller I want the app to propose the one next step per account so that I start my day with a clear list.

Acceptance criteria:
* The card names the action, the reason and the data it used.
* The seller can accept, snooze or reject the proposal.
* Rejected proposals are not shown again for 14 days.

Summary: Draft a follow-up e-mail from the last meeting note
Description:
As a seller I want a draft follow-up e-mail based on my note so that I send it the same day.

Acceptance criteria:
* The draft is in the language of the customer.
* Nothing is sent without the seller pressing send.
* The draft lists which note it used.

Summary: Ask questions about the pipeline in plain language
Description:
As a sales manager I want to ask 'which deals above 100k are at risk this quarter?' so that I get an answer without building a report.

Acceptance criteria:
* The answer names the deals and the source figures.
* The assistant only reads data the manager is allowed to see.
* Questions it cannot answer are said so, without guessing.
